Stack Trendigle-prod-Instance
Resources
[~] AWS::EC2::Instance Box BoxA0510527 may be replaced
 └─ [~] UserData (may cause replacement)
     └─ [~] .Fn::Base64:
         ├─ [-] old
         └─ [+] #!/bin/bash
set -x
dnf install -y nodejs22 tar gzip
curl -fsSL https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/releases/download/v2.11.9/caddy_2.11.9_linux_arm64.tar.gz | tar xz -C /usr/bin caddy
groupadd --system caddy
useradd --system --gid caddy --create-home --home-dir /var/lib/caddy --shell /usr/sbin/nologin caddy
install -d /etc/caddy/conf.d
echo 'import /etc/caddy/conf.d/*.caddy' > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
cat > /etc/systemd/system/caddy.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Caddy
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=notify
User=caddy
Group=caddy
ExecStart=/usr/bin/caddy run --environ --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
ExecReload=/usr/bin/caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --force
TimeoutStopSec=5s
LimitNOFILE=1048576
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable caddy
